identity.description: Pylon is a customer support platform (usepylon.com) for B2B support teams, with issues, accounts, and contacts, plus an API, webhooks, and an MCP server.
identity.identity_notes: Docs at docs.usepylon.com and the marketing site usepylon.com describe the Pylon customer support platform. Matches category Support and Helpdesk and the usepylon.com hint.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth 2.0 is used for the MCP server (interactive client sign-in). The direct REST API uses API tokens; no REST OAuth flow was found in the sources.
auth.token_refresh: unknown (API tokens are static; no refresh flow documented in fetched sources)
auth.scopes_notes: API tokens can be restricted by IP address or CIDR (up to 20 entries). A token either has its own identity with a role chosen at creation, or acts as a user/bot and uses that user's role. Domain restrictions are not mentioned.

access.production_restrictions: Sandbox environment is listed only in the Enterprise column of the pricing feature table. Plan gating for API access is inferred from table layout, not stated explicitly. Only Admin users can create API tokens, so a developer needs an Admin seat in the workspace.

api.rate_limits: unknown (a separate rate limits page is linked from the API docs; contents not fetched)
api.limitations: Docs show examples of fetching customers/issues and creating issues; the full endpoint list is in the API Reference, which was not fetched. Rate-limit page linked but not fetched.
